fragments.source: This source candidate pairs Terrace Stitch, Survey Wheel and Breakwater Return with twelve original reward stills in four independent owners: `moving-edges-fpv`, `moving-edges-ukraine`, `moving-edges-retro` and `moving-edges-coupa`. The three geometry families remain three maps across all four themes. Runtime catalog admission, production assessment, native play and public delivery are separate work.

The other arguments are `fpv`, `retro` and `coupa`. Export produces `descriptor.json`, `pack.json`, `media.rlmedia` and `inputs.json`. Outputs stay outside tracked source; ordinary-path checks do not claim protection against hostile concurrent filesystem renames.
